description: Search several stores at once (Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Best Buy and Target by default; a Shopify store only when its domain is given in shopify_domains) for what the user asks for, compare price, shipping, delivery, rating and seller, and pick the best offer per item with a one-line reason. Read-only: nothing is added to a cart and nothing is bought. Returns a run_id for the next steps, the comparison table and the picks.

budget.description: Total budget in dollars across all stores

request.description: What to buy, in plain words, e.g. "usb-c hub and 6 ft hdmi cable under $60"

shopify_domains.description: Shopify store domains to include, e.g. shop.example.com

stores.description: Stores to search. Default: the user's allowed stores.

zip.description: Delivery ZIP code for prices and delivery dates

name: find_and_compare
